exposure: one abnormal value on the 3-hour oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT)
outcome: composite neonatal morbidity of at least one fetus
cohort: The study included 2,597 women with twin gestations who underwent a 3-hour oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT).
finding: Women with twin gestation and one abnormal value on the 3-hour OGTT were found to have higher rates of preterm delivery < 32 weeks, large for gestational age neonates, and composite neonatal morbidity of at least one fetus, but similar maternal outcomes, compared to those with a normal screen.
